exercises.title: Neural Sync: Procedural Tower Placement
exercises.description: Professional grid generation with nested loops for tactical positioning.
exercises.targetCode:
# Generate 3x3 defensive grid
spacing = 100
for row in range(3):
    for col in range(3):
        x = col * spacing
        y = row * spacing
        print(f'Tower at ({x}, {y})')

exercises.title: Perimeter Defense: Coverage Calculator
exercises.description: Area is 600x400. Tower spacing is 100. Calculate how many towers fit: (width/spacing) × (height/spacing).
exercises.starterCode:
# Defense coverage analysis
width = 600
height = 400
spacing = 100
exercises.solution:
width = 600
height = 400
spacing = 100
towers_x = width // spacing
towers_y = height // spacing
total = towers_x * towers_y
print(total)

spacing = 100
for x in range(0, max_x + 1, spacing):
    print(x)
